requirement: Vault locks name their owner and clear only when provably abandoned, the sweep reports held keys, the footer sits inside the email, and simulate is not stuck on a source-blocked recipient

oracle.invariant:
abandonedLock is true only for the same host with a different run whose pid is ours or gone; another host, a live pid, our own run or a malformed owner is false. A lock left by an earlier run of this pid is renamed to .lock.abandoned- and the key reads; a lock naming another host stays and answers REAL_KEY_BUSY. drain resolves true once a create holding the lock finishes. sweepExpired returns realKeyErrors [{campaignId, code: REAL_KEY_BUSY, expired: false}] for a held key on every pass, with no address in it. A generated draft carries

with the footer once, and still once after the draft is saved again. After an approved recipient opts out in source mode, re-approval answers 409 and simulate answers 200 with no attempt; the address-change case answers 200 with no attempt.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/db/index.js:52 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a lock is cleared only when its owner is provably gone: same host and a finished run
an abandoned lock from an earlier run is renamed aside and the vault opens; a foreign one stays
drain waits for an operation holding a lock and reports idle
the hourly sweep names a campaign whose key is held, every pass, by id and code only
the system footer is a muted line inside the email and stays single when a draft is saved again
a recipient who opts out after approval is left out of the run instead of blocking it
source changes invalidate customized draft, and a changed address that cannot be re-approved is left out of the run
